Failure mechanism illustrated: Compromise of a software production process
Relevant existing approaches: Protected builds, provenance, controlled production changes, independent release authority
Scope of the lesson: Trusted distribution and valid signatures do not alone prove benign content

Failure mechanism illustrated: CI helper code inherits access to sensitive build information
Relevant existing approaches: Controlled inputs, isolated execution, narrow identities, integrity verification
Scope of the lesson: Dependency origin and execution privilege must both be considered

Failure mechanism illustrated: Vulnerable legitimate component remains in deployed software
Relevant existing approaches: Component inventories, advisory response, update and containment processes
Scope of the lesson: Inventory supports response but does not remediate exposure itself
